query: What is Telegram's most recently reported number of monthly active users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Telegram’s most recently reported monthly active users are “significantly more than 1 billion” monthly active users, reported by Pavel Durov on March 19, 2025 [1]. Telegram’s most recently reported full-time employee count in the provided sources is about 30 full-time employees, reported in March 2025 as “about 30 full-time employees” [2]. The primary sources are TASS (for the MAU figure) [1] and Contrary Research (for the employee figure) [2].
